session.description: Three Mars surface bases reach Earth through relays: UHF to two low relay orbiters (MRO and TGO class) and to an areostationary relay over 105 E, X-band crosslinks between them, an optical trunk across the Earth-Mars light time (338 s one way at the 2027 opposition) to an Earth GEO relay, and LCRD-class optical links to two ground stations. Every relay and endpoint host runs NASA HDTN with LTP over UDP; Mars and Earth each run an IS-IS instance, joined by a static boundary over the trunk.
session.display_name: Earth to Mars DTN relay chain (HDTN)
session.name: earth-mars-hdtn-relay
